highlights.title: Altman Tells Staff OpenAI Has No Say Over Pentagon Decisions
highlights.description: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman told employees that the company doesn’t get to make the call about what the Defense Department does with its artificial intelligence software and suggested the desire to do so may have been part of tensions between the Pentagon and rival Anthropic PBC.

highlights.title: Nvidia, Amazon temporarily close Dubai offices, Google employees stranded amid U.S.-Iran war
highlights.description: Tech companies with Middle East operations have scrambled to respond as fighting rippled across the region after joint U.S.-Israeli strikes in Iran.

highlights.title: Sam Altman tells OpenAI staffers that military's 'operational decisions' are up to the government
highlights.description: In an all-hands meetings with OpenAI employees on Tuesday, CEO Sam Altman said his company doesn't get to choose how the military uses its technology.

highlights.title: Did Alibaba just kneecap its powerful Qwen AI team? Key figures depart in wake of latest open source release
highlights.description: Alibaba's Qwen team of AI researchers have been among the most prolific and well-regarded by international machine learning community — shipping dozens of powerful generalized and specialized generative models starting last summer, most of them entirely open source and free. highlights.title: Alibaba AI Wizard Who Warned of US-China Tech Gap Steps Down
highlights.description: The architect of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.’s chief AI model has quit his post, a surprise departure that’s rattled the developer community and raised questions about the Chinese online leader’s pivot to artificial intelligence.

highlights.description: Nvidia Corp. is investing in Oxa, the latest British autonomous driving startup to receive backing from the world’s most valuable company.
